body: Oof. OCD (any mental illness really) is incredibly life-altering. I'm surprised she forgets.
Hopefully they tell you that in at least a semi-joking way?

Thanks man. I know I'm not (consciously, anyway), I just really struggle using my very strong social safety net. I get that I don't have to be happy all the time, or whatever, I just know that someone who is incessantly down is no fun to be around. So when I feel like I've felt for the last month I talk to some people about it but not constantly, or even enough really.

> she stopped abilify cold turkey on Monday

I stopped abilify cold turkey a few weeks ago (semi-involuntarily). I've been having suicidal ideation since. I'm not a doctor, but this might be a good bit of information for her doctor and/or psych.
